Uredan intenzitet signala svih koštanih struktura.
Femoralna i tibijalna hrskavica izrazito stanjene, osobito u medijalnom kompartmentu FT zgloba,
gdje je vidljiva gotovo denudacija kosti, no bez koštanog edema - promjene u smislu
hondromalacije 3. stupnja.
Manji izljev u koljenu. Edem prepatelarnog potkožog masnog tkiva.
Prednji križni ligament povišenog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu - u smislu degeneracije.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Oba meniska mukoidno degenerirana uz protruziju korpusa medijalnog meniska.
Degenerativna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Povišen intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta u smislu
tendinopatije/degenerativnih promjena.
Entezofiti na hvatištu tetive kvadricepsa.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Stanjenje i hondromalacijske promjene patelarne i trohlerane hrskavice 3. stupnja uzt rubne osteofite.
Manja poplitealna cista.

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala lateralnog
kolateralnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Kompleksna degenerativna ruptura medijalnog meniska u području stražnjeg roga i korpusa.
Korpus meniska periferno je potisnut s posljedičnim reaktivnim periligamentarnim edemom
medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta. U području stražnjeg roga nalazi se meniscealna kost 8 x 9 x
4 mm (LLx AP x CC).
Lateralni menisk degenerativno je promijenjen.
Mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamenta te manjim dijelom stražnjeg križnog
ligamenta.
Plitke fisure hrskavice lateralnog kondila femura i tibije (hondromalacija 2. stupnja prema ICRS
klasifikaciji).
Potpuni gubitak hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura i tibije sa subhondralnim koštanim edemom.
U patelofemoralnom zglobu nalaze se fisure do pune debljine hrsakvice s manjim fokalnim
zonama subhondralnog koštanog edema patele (hondromalacija 3. stupnja prema ICRS
klasifikaciji).
Opsežna rubna osteofitoza zglobnih tijela.
Opisano u sklopu uznapredovalih OA promjena.
Lamelarna tekuća kolekcija površno od iliotibijalnog traktusa. Sam iliotibijalni traktus urednih je
intenziteta signala.
Opsežan izljev u koljenu uz umjerenu proliferaciju sinovije, te lipoma arborescens u
suprapatelarnom recesusu. Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial sided knee pain for 2 months, patient is a runner.
Comparison: Radiographs of the left knee 2/[DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Moderate osseous stress involving the patella. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is otherwise normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects./

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with superimposed low-grade interstitial partial-thickness tearing of the anterior mid fibers. Superimposed osseous stress involving the patella..
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Mechanical stress across the extensor mechanism characterized by mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with low-grade interstitial tearing, as well as superimposed edema throughout the patella.

Regelrechte Artikulations- und Stellungsverhältnisse im Kniegelenk. Keine relevanten Degenerationen. Flächige Signalalterationen an der Patellabasis (8/8) mit partieller Assoziation zur Quadricepssehne als mögliches Schmerzkorrelat. MR-morphologisch kein eindeutiger Frakturnachweis. Ansonsten allseits regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kein Hinweis auf eine Fraktur oder ein Bone-bruise. Allenfalls minimale Signalalterationen des retropatellaren Knorpels der medialen Facette (4/14). Keine höhergradige Chondropathie femoropatellar und femorotibial. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband sowie Kollateralbänder intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Regelrechte Konfiguration der Menisken ohne H.a. Rissbildung. Akzentuiert Gelenkflüssigkeit. Bakerzyste. Unauffällige Darstellung der Weichteile.

Technique: MRI of the knee. ACL normal. MCL normal. Degenerative changes of both menisci. Chondromalatic changes of all three compartments. Large effusion. No baker's cyst. Conclusion: Degenerative changes of both menisci. Chondromalatic changes of all three compartments. Large effusion.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain. 
Comparison: [REDACTED]. 

TECHNIQUE:  Multiplanar and multisequence MRI of the left  knee without IV contrast.   

FINDINGS: 

JOINT EFFUSION:  No significant knee joint effusion. Small complex popliteal cyst. 

ANTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

POSTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

MEDIAL MENISCUS: Complete tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus. Associated moderate peripheral extrusion, with the meniscal body projecting 5 mm beyond the tibial margin. There is also a horizontal undersurface tear of the meniscal body. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:  There is partial and full-thickness cartilage loss involving the medial tibial plateau with mild degree of subchondral bone marrow edema. There is also mild thinning of the femoral cartilage. 

LATERAL MENISCUS:  Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:  Within normal limits. 

MEDIAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT:  Proximal thickening of the medial collateral ligament, representing sequela of prior sprain. 

LATERAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT COMPLEX:  Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: There is a focal full-thickness cartilage fissure of the lateral patellar facet, with mild full-thickness delamination. Moderate degree of associated subchondral bone marrow edema. Trochlear cartilage is intact. 

EXTENSOR APPARATUS:  Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. 

BONE MARROW:  No fracture. 
 
OTHER:  None. 


IMPRESSION:

1. Complete tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus, with moderate peripheral meniscal extrusion. There is also a horizontal undersurface tear of the posterior body.

2. Mild medial compartment osteoarthritis.

3. Full-thickness cartilage fissure of the lateral patellar facet.

4. Small popliteal cyst.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Geringe mukoide Degeneration des Innenmeniskushinterhorns. Kleine Ganglionzyste in der Tibia angrenzend an das Innenmeniskushinterhorn.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Geringe Ausdünnung des Knorpel an der medialen Femurcondyle in der Belastungszone. Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt, kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Intakter Außenmeniskus.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Fokaler tiefgreifender Knorpeldefekt in der lateralen Patellafacette (Serie 7/ Image 12). Keinn vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt, kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder. Kleine Zyste an der Insertion des HKB.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. 7 x 9 mm messende, umschriebene, rundliche Läsion mit in der PD TSE FS hyperintensem und der T2 eher hypointensem Signalverhalten mit feinen Septierungen mittig in der distalen Femurmetaphyse (Serie 4/ Image 17).

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs anterior-posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmektedir. Medial menisküs diz ekleminden 5 mm mediale esktrüdedir. Menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyon ve serbest kenarda horizontal yırtık izlenmiştir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patella medial fasette subkondral ödem, kartilajda belirgin incelme izlenmiştir. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Femur lateral kondilde tibiofemoral eklem komşuluğunda subkondral 10x6 mm boyutlu osteokondral defekt izlenmiştir. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma izlenmiştir. Ekleme komşu tibia medial platoda subartiküler fraktür ve komşu kemik iliğinde ödem izlenmiştir. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlenmiştir. Kemik yapı köşelerinde de milimetrik osteofitik sivrileşme izlenmektedir. Popliteal fossada 5x3 cm boyutlu Baker kisti izlenmiştir. Popliteal fossa seviyesinde cilt altı multipl varisler izlenmiştir.SONUÇ:Gonartroz.Tibia medial platoda subartiküler fraktür ve komşu kemik iliği ödemi.Femur lateral kondilde osteokondral defekt.Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon.Medial menisküste mediale esktrüzyon grade III meniskopati ve horizontal yırtık.Lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati.Patella medial fasette  grade III kondromalazi.Popliteal fossada Baker kisti.

Gonalgia derecha.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial, que no
impresiona contactar pelvis articular, sin caracteres propios

Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga del compartimento femorotibial medial.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial lateral y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
Aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
No hay derrame articular y quistes poplíteos.

Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.

Impresión:

Signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula y de fricción de la banda iliotibial.
